name: Hack Menu
description: A mod menu with noclip, speedhack, hitboxes, click buffer, survival delay, frame advance, FPS bypass and safe mode.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: You can't die. Marks the attempt as cheated.

speedhack.name: Speedhack
speedhack.description: Run the whole game faster or slower.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Game speed multiplier used while Speedhack is on.

speedhack-audio.name: Speedhack audio
speedhack-audio.description: Change music and sound pitch to match the speed.

hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
hitboxes.description: Draw hitboxes outside practice mode too.

click-buffer.name: Click buffer
click-buffer.description: Holds jump clicks that would do nothing (mid-air, no orb) and fires them once you land or touch an orb. Forces safe mode.

buffer-steps.name: Buffer steps
buffer-steps.description: How many physics steps (240 per second) a click can be held.

survival-delay.name: Survival delay
survival-delay.description: Holds a jump press or release for a few frames if it would kill you, and cancels it if it still would. Checks by simulating an invisible copy of you ahead. Forces safe mode.

delay-steps.name: Max delay
delay-steps.description: How long a deadly input may be held waiting for a safe moment, in physics steps (240 per second; 16 is about 4 frames at 60 FPS). A press that's never safe in that window is cancelled if not jumping survives.

max-lookahead.name: Max lookahead
max-lookahead.description: Longest an input's trajectory is followed, in physics steps (240 per second). Jumps are followed until you land; ship, wave, UFO and swing inputs for about 0.2 s.

frame-advance.name: Frame advance
frame-advance.description: Freezes gameplay. Press F7 to step forward. Forces safe mode.

advance-steps.name: Advance steps
advance-steps.description: Physics steps run per F7 press.

fps-bypass.name: FPS bypass
fps-bypass.description: Use your own frame rate instead of GD's. Turn VSync off for it to go above your refresh rate.

fps.name: FPS
fps.description: Frame rate used while FPS bypass is on.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Don't save any progress from attempts. Always on while click buffer, survival delay, frame advance or speedhack is active.

cheat-indicator.name: Cheat indicator
cheat-indicator.description: Shows 'Cheating' or 'Safe mode' in the corner while playing.
